Set number of shared audio tags. See [Using the numberOfSharedAudioTags prop](/docs/player/autoplay#using-the-numberofsharedaudiotags-prop) for more information.

## CLI flag

```text
--number-of-shared-audio-tags <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---
Config.setNumberOfSharedAudioTags(5);
```
